newsitem.title: USA: Loewen says can proceed with antitrust suit.
newsitem.headline: Loewen says can proceed with antitrust suit.

text.p: Loewen Group Inc said a U.S. district court judge ruled that it can proceed with its antitrust lawsuit against hostile bidder Service Corp International.
The Vancouver-based funeral services company said Judge Frederic Block denied Service Corp's motion to dismiss the lawsuit, ruling that it was "anticipatory and preemptive".

Loewen's lawsuit against Service Corp contends that its unsolicited bid would substantially reduce market competition. Several states have launched investigations into potential antitrust implication of a transaction.
Service Corp is the largest funeral services company in North America and Loewen is its chief rival. Service Corp is offering to buy Loewen for $2.9 billion.

In a statement, Service Corp acknowledged the denial of the motion, noting the decision is not a ruling on the merits of the lawsuit. It also reiterated that any competitive overlaps can be resolved by divesting properties.
